name: LinkLater — Local Read-Later Vault & One-Click Obsidian Bridge
summary: Saves any webpage—along with your highlighted quote, personal note, and custom tags—into an instant-search local read-later vault in your browser side panel, with one-click export to Markdown or Obsidian.
